title: Object Repository element replacements
description: A non-empty array with one entry per element, each pairing an existing Object Repository element with the target anchorable definition file whose target replaces it; the element keeps its reference ID.

referenceId.description: Reference ID of the Object Repository element to replace, as printed by create-elements or get-elements.

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target anchorable definition file to replace the element with, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.
